learning_outcomes.text: Students master mathematical techniques: eigenvalue determination, coordinate transformation, gradient, transition matrix, multi-dimensional integration, convergence analysis of (complex) number series, solving differential equations by separation of variables, solving homogeneous and linear differential equations.

They understand mathematical concepts: axis and principal axis transformation, error estimation, decomposition of multi-dimensional integrals, structure of the solution set of a linear differential equation.
Students know mathematical techniques: simple multi-dimensional substitutions, series expansion of a function, solving differential equations by series approach.
They know applications and acquire skills in applying mathematical results.
They possess abilities in presenting results through lecture of exercise solutions.

syllabus_topics: Linear Algebra: Matrices, Determinants, Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors, Coordinate Transformation, Principal Axes
Functions of several variables: Limit, Continuity, Derivative of real- and vector-valued functions, Line integrals, Volume integrals
Series: Power series, Taylor series, Complex number series

Differential Equations: Separation of variables, Similarity differential equations, Exact differential equations, Linear homogeneous and inhomogeneous differential equations, Linear systems of differential equations
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam. Active participation in the exercises is a prerequisite for exam admission. The weighting for the final grade is based on credit points.
